facts.fact: The 2026 finance law (loi n°021-2025/ALT of 27 December 2025) appropriates XOF 1,916,611,000 in domestic payment credits to programme 136, Digital transformation and ecosystem, of the digital ministry (MTD-PCE), covering e-government, the WURI identity programme, the ANSSI and digital entrepreneurship; the figure is a floor, as counterpart funding is not apportioned.
facts.system: MTD-PCE programme 136, Transformation et écosystème numérique, budget year 2026

note: Only one budget year (2026) is given, so no rose or fell fact.
